tokens.name: brand-plaster
tokens.usage: Brand primitive. Lime-washed plaster: the lightest ground. Use semantic tokens in UI; primitives are for marketing, print and illustration.

tokens.name: brand-sand
tokens.usage: Brand primitive. Sand: the page ground of the light theme.

tokens.name: brand-terracotta
tokens.usage: Brand primitive. Terracotta: the brand colour; the logo symbol and primary actions.

tokens.name: brand-sea
tokens.usage: Brand primitive. Deep sea: links, information, focus.

tokens.name: brand-olive
tokens.usage: Brand primitive. Olive: success, work done.

tokens.name: brand-saffron
tokens.usage: Brand primitive. Saffron: warm highlight, illustration fills. Never text on light grounds (1.9:1).

tokens.name: brand-umber
tokens.usage: Brand primitive. Umber ink: text and the dark theme's ground family.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (sand / umber night).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table bodies, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawers, menus, toasts: anything floating above a surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: table header rows, code/filename chips, the track of a meter or switch.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects, checkboxes, secondary buttons (3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and headings on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, helper text on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken (≥4.5:1 on each).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on inverse grounds (tooltip).

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltip and snackbar ground.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, selected tab indicator, the brand's one loud colour. As text: on surface and surface-raised only (large or bold).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent-strong text (selected rows, active LanguageSwitch segment).

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Terracotta as small text on accent-soft or surfaces.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. In dark, accent is light, so this is dark.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Links and informational text/icons on bg, surface, surface-raised.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind info text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text/icons on bg, surface, success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text/icons on bg, surface, warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors (C's oxblood, kept apart from terracotta by lightness and always paired with an icon + word).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind danger text.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (the destructive button).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: solid 2px, 2px offset. ≥3:1 on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: status-filed-fg
tokens.usage: StatusPill 'Filed by Mona' text + check icon, on status-filed-bg.

tokens.name: status-filed-bg
tokens.usage: StatusPill 'Filed by Mona' fill (solid tint, no border).

tokens.name: status-review-fg
tokens.usage: StatusPill 'Needs review' text + question icon, on status-review-bg.

tokens.name: status-review-bg
tokens.usage: StatusPill 'Needs review' fill; also carries a 1px status-review-fg border.

tokens.name: status-processing-fg
tokens.usage: StatusPill 'Processing' text, spinner and dashed border (no fill) on any ground.

tokens.name: status-unreadable-fg
tokens.usage: StatusPill 'Unreadable' text + crossed-file icon, on status-unreadable-bg.

tokens.name: status-unreadable-bg
tokens.usage: StatusPill 'Unreadable' fill; also carries a diagonal hatch.

tokens.name: confidence-high
tokens.usage: ConfidenceMeter filled segments at ≥85%. Always shown with the % and a word.

tokens.name: confidence-mid
tokens.usage: ConfidenceMeter filled segments at 60–84%.

tokens.name: confidence-low
tokens.usage: ConfidenceMeter filled segments below 60%.

tokens.name: confidence-track
tokens.usage: ConfidenceMeter empty segments.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing and onboarding hero only. One per screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on the web app (Journal, Documents, Rules).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog and drawer titles, empty-state headlines.

styles.name: voice
styles.sample: J’ai trouvé 4 courriers AGIPI. Personnels ou professionnels ?
styles.usage: Mona's own question or answer at the top of a card. The editorial moment in the UI: never for labels.

styles.name: voice-italic
styles.usage: Mona's margin notes (rule explanations, 'why I filed it here'). Sparingly.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and section headings inside the app.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Filed to SCM Dr Laurent / Prévoyance / 2026.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body, document names, button labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, helper text, citations. Minimum size for any text.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels. Never for sentences; never in Romanian/French body copy.

styles.name: filename
styles.usage: Original and new filenames, journal IDs. System mono: no webfont.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; icon-to-label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between related elements; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card gap between blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; dialog padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section gap within a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Marketing section rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, meter segments, keyboard chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Filename chips, tooltips, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, table containers, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Moodboard tiles, attachment previews, drawers' inner corners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, StatusPill, LanguageSwitch, Tabs indicator, avatars.

shadow.note: Warm umber shadows in light; plain black in dark. Elevation is quiet: most separation comes from surface colour and hairlines.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards on bg.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts, hovered cards.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs and drawers.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers, app bar.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Drawer and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialog and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast stack.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips.

layout.note: Breakpoints and container widths. Breakpoints are for reference in media queries; containers are used by the Container component.

tokens.name: breakpoint-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones and up. Media queries only (CSS variables don't work inside @media); mirror these numbers.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: Tablets and up: two-column layouts, container padding space-8.

tokens.name: breakpoint-lg
tokens.usage: Laptops and up: persistent side navigation.

tokens.name: breakpoint-xl
tokens.usage: Desktops: dashboards at full density, container padding space-12 from 1200px.

tokens.name: container-sm
tokens.usage: Container size sm: reading width, forms, dialogs' content, settings.

tokens.name: container-md
tokens.usage: Container size md: chat, single-column pages with tables.

tokens.name: container-lg
tokens.usage: Container size lg (default): app pages and dashboards.

tokens.name: container-xl
tokens.usage: Container size xl: wide dashboards and marketing pages.
